description: Shape any question you put to the user as one self-contained decision with one recommendation, never a menu, and decide for yourself when the act is reversible and inside your own scope. Use whenever you are about to ask the user something mid-task: which approach to take, whether to proceed, how to handle an ambiguity, or which of several options to pick. Trigger phrases include "stop asking me so much", "just decide", "one decision at a time", "don't give me a menu", "why are you asking me this", "make the call".
